notes.title: Lost But Found v1.2.1 - Bug Fixes! (Yes, It's Overdue)
notes.content:
Hey Officers!

Lost But Found started as a Game Jam game, and our devs working on this game were inexperienced, so some of the systems were too complicated for us to reference these following bugs. 

Now, one of our senior devs has rewritten some of the aspects and routines of the game.

[b]🪲 Table Upgrade Bug[/b]

We fixed an issue where sometimes the table upgrade is not saved or not retained for the following day. We rewrote the system for this.

[b]🐞 Called Passengers Asking for Wrong Item Bug[/b]

We fixed this issue, by rewriting this system.

[b]🐛 QR Code Reader Issue[/b]

We have disabled this item in a previous patch because of its buggy nature, we rewrote the system for this to make sure its all working as expected.

[b]🐝 Infinite Black Market Glitch[/b]

There was an issue where players were able to sell a black market item multiple times to make money :) We patched this one.

Thank you for hanging in there, me and my team tested these new fixes, but we will be on the lookout for any recurring bugs. Feel free to use our Steam Community Forums to help us reference more bugs.

Again, a sincere apology here for my previous lead dev, it's the nature of software development. I know it's a bit late, but we will make sure the game has zero bugs with the upcoming updates.

Cheers!

---

notes.title: Lost But Found v1.2.0 - Arcade Update (New Items & Minigames) Major Update

notes.title: Lost But Found v1.1.1 - Late Game Performance Fix & Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hey Officers!

We have had some feedbacks about low end laptops/PC's (even some beefy ones) having issues with a lot of items in the table causing lag, or heating up their laptop. 

When we invesitaged the issue, we figured the colliders and Unity physics computation was causing this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187869/b04dd753df4f0ad15c20b4e9775e710dd0c5b289.png[/img]

We fixed up all colliders of in game items manually with a better collider, and depending on our tests with low end devices, this issues should be all fixed. Let us know if you are having any performans related issues.

[h2]Upcoming Free Update: Cafe Update![/h2]

To give you a sneak peak from our upcoming free content update (you don't need to install any DLCs) which will be released on June 7th;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187869/b000fee4c31d1cc55368245cd9456888bfb54bb9.png[/img]

Yes, there will be a cafe where you can go and buy coffee. I repeat, you can drink coffee in the game. And other beverages. These drinks will have special effects for your run, make you work faster (caffeine right) or slow down patience bar etc.

This update will also add 20 new in-game lost items to spice up your runs. And additional functional items in stores.

Thanks for being a part of the [b]Lost but Found[/b] community!

notes.title: Lost But Found v1.1.0 - Terminals Update (New Items & Minigames)
notes.content:
Hey Officers!

The [b]Terminals Update[/b] has just landed, bringing new items, mini-games, and quality-of-life improvements to [b]Lost But Found[/b]! Get ready to handle even more lost belongings and test your skills in new ways. Here's what’s new:

[h3]🆕 New Features & Content[/h3]  

[b]🔹 New Passenger Items[/b] – Our artist added 20 more items that passengers lost, which would increase variety. And we already planned more items.

[b]🔹 New Minigames[/b] – Some boarding passes are now incomplete! Solve the gate assignment puzzle before handing them over.  

[b]🔹 Cardboard Box Minigame[/b] – Use the [b]Utility Knife[/b] to unbox surprise items! Cut along the taped lines and see what’s inside.  

[b]🔹 New Items in the Shop[/b] –  
[list]  
[*] [b]Utility Knife[/b] – A must-have for opening sealed cardboard boxes.  
[*] [b]Sticker Booster Pack[/b] – Collect and trade stickers! Available in [b]Common, Rare, and Legendary[/b] packs.  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187869/112ae7c829ead9258f43b0d437e184bc4106f54b.png[/img]

[h3]⚙️ Gameplay & Balance Updates[/h3]  

[b]🔹 Trash Can Penalty Removed[/b] – No more penalties for discarding unwanted items in any mode.  

[b]🔹 Boarding Passes Now Have Value[/b] – Completing the gate assignment minigame correctly rewards a [b]higher payout[/b].  

[b]🔹 Bigger Shop Inventory[/b] – More variety in daily shop refreshes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187869/66ffa5ba2a3eca6f3879bbcd43cb20567413c2fa.png[/img]

[h3]🎮 Quality of Life & Fixes[/h3]  

[b]🔹 Partial Controller Support[/b] – Basic game controls now work on Steam Deck!  

[b]🔹 Better Visual Feedback[/b] – Black market items now have a [b]blinking animation[/b], and [b]trash bins now flash[/b] when overflowing.  

[b]🔹 Dynamic Music Rotation[/b] – No more hearing the same tune over and over!

This update is now live! 🚀 Play [b]Lost But Found[/b] today and tell us what you think!

[b]Happy organizing! 🏷️✨[/b]

notes.title: Lost But Found v1.0.9 - Feeback Update - Bug Fixes & Balances
notes.content:
Hey Officers!

We have been reading your reviews and listen to your ideas in discord and steam community forums. We made a list of common feedbacks that we wanted to handle right away.

And we have some bug fixes, especially some localization issues for Portuguese and Spanish languages.

Here are the full changes;

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Thief Delay Adjusted:[/b] The thief now takes 1 second before starting to steal.
[*][b]QR Code Reader Rework:[/b] The QR code reader has been redesigned! It now shows the price of the item you’re holding in real-time, without any cooldown or waiting.
[*][b]"Something Fun" Request:[/b] The “something fun” customer request now automatically selects an item already available on the table. This will help players who were unsure about what to provide.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Phone Call Bug:[/b] Fixed an issue where customers wouldn't arrive after calling them via phone number.
[*][b]Duplicate Requests:[/b] Resolved the bug where 2-3 customers would request the exact same items simultaneously.
[*][b]Item Crash Fix:[/b] Fixed a crash that occurred when giving an item to a customer just as they were leaving.
[*][b]Tutorial Issues:[/b] Some players reported errors during the tutorial. We’ve reviewed and resolved those problems for smoother onboarding.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Trash Bin Notification:[/b] There’s no penalty for using the trash bin! If there are more than 30 items on the table, the bin will flash as a reminder for players who might forget.
[*][b]Black Market Highlights:[/b] The designated spots for placing items on the black market are now more clearly marked to avoid confusion.
[/list]

We also added the upcoming building sprites to the map, to tease them! Arcade and Coffee Shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187869/7c36e547f388277383949a5726105177afcaf36c.png[/img]

We’re committed to improving the game and ensuring the best experience for all players. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming! Let us know what you think of these changes and if there's anything else you’d like to see.

Thanks for being a part of the [b]Lost but Found[/b] community!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204250/Lost_But_Found/

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

notes.title: Lost But Found v1.0.8 - Optimization Update - Bug Fixes & Optimization
notes.content:
Hey Officers!

Thank you for all the attention you’ve been showing our game lately! Your feedback and enthusiasm mean the world to us, and we’re thrilled to share a new update packed with fixes and improvements based on your input.

Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2][list]
[*] Crash Issue: We’ve resolved the pesky crashing problem to keep your gameplay uninterrupted.
[*] Item Push Issue: Fixed the issue where selected items would push surrounding objects incorrectly.
[*] Trash Issue: Items mistakenly sent to the trash when given to customers? Not anymore!
[*] Magnifying Glass: The magnifying glass is now fully functional and working as intended.
[*] Bomb Minigame: Squashed some bugs to make this minigame more explosive—in a good way!
[*] Journal: Addressed and fixed several reported issues for a smoother experience.
[/list]
[h2]Steam Deck Enhancements
[/h2][list]
[*] Improved overall performance on Steam Deck, ensuring the game runs better than ever.
[*] Updated the tutorial to be more compatible and seamless for Steam Deck users.
[/list]
[h2]General Improvements
[/h2][list]
[*] Optimization tweaks for smoother gameplay and better performance across the board.
[*] Translation quality has been improved to enhance accessibility and clarity for all players.
[*] We hope this update enhances your experience and helps you dive deeper into the world we’ve created. Keep that feedback coming—it’s invaluable in helping us make the game even better!
[/list]

Thank you for being part of our journey. Until next time, stay vigilant, Officers!
